result.question: Why did priests say Uzziah trespassed?

readings.answer: Because he tried to offer incense, which only Aaron’s priestly descendants were authorized to burn.
readings.support: you have no right to offer incense to the LORD | Only the priests, the descendants of Aaron, are consecrated to burn incense

assessments.reason: The passage says, “you have no right to offer incense… Only the priests, the descendants of Aaron, are consecrated to burn incense,” matching the claim that only priests can burn incense.

result.reason: The text explicitly states only priests (descendants of Aaron) may burn incense, which is why Uzziah’s act was a trespass.
